'''Jos Mayda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Garos IV]], who was the son of [[Desto Mayda]] and a childhood friend of [[Dair Haslip]].

==Biography==
In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an official presence on Garos IV and ended the [[Garosian civil war]]. Very enthusiastic, Jos Mayda decided to join the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] but all his hopes were halted when his father was revealed as a [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|rebel]] and wanted by the Empire.<ref name="Turning Point" />

[[File:Dair_and_scoutrooper.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Dair shot down the [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] who killed Jos.]]

Some days before his friend Dair entered at the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|academy]], they were walking around Garos IV when they were attacked by two Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] looking for a deserter. Jos was shot down for no reason and Dair killed them. This convinced Dair to join the resistance and enter at the academy as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="Turning Point" />
